key: VICTORIA: And we're in!
en: VICTORIA: And we're in!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 入れた!

key: ...Not exactly sure where we're in, but we are definitely in.
en: ...Not exactly sure where we're in, but we are definitely in.
ja: …どこに入ったのかはよくわからないけど、確かに中には入れたわ。

key: HARDY: Oi, there you are!
en: HARDY: Oi, there you are!
ja: ハーディ: おい、いたのか!

key: Was wondering where you went until I heard that huge noise!
en: Was wondering where you went until I heard that huge noise!
ja: どこ行ったのかと思ってたら、あのでかい音が聞こえてさ!

key: VICTORIA: Oh, you made it out of Labradorra too.
en: VICTORIA: Oh, you made it out of Labradorra too.
ja: ヴィクトリア: あ、あなたもラブラドラから抜け出せたのね。

key: HARDY: You bet!
en: HARDY: You bet!
ja: ハーディ: 当たり前だろ!

key: Nothing's keepin' me from Aya!
en: Nothing's keepin' me from Aya!
ja: 何があってもアヤのところに行くのを止められねえ!

key: ...Except an apparent lack of any way to get to her.
en: ...Except an apparent lack of any way to get to her.
ja: …彼女のところまで行く方法がまるでないってこと以外はな。

key: There ain't even a way to climb up that cliff face Fern's towerin' above.
en: There ain't even a way to climb up that cliff face Fern's towerin' above.
ja: ファーンがそびえ立ってるあの崖、登る道すらねえんだ。

key: I was lookin' for another way around when I ended up down here.
en: I was lookin' for another way around when I ended up down here.
ja: 別の回り道を探してたら、いつの間にかこんな下まで来ちまった。

key: You guys got a plan?!
en: You guys got a plan?!
ja: お前ら、作戦あんのか?!

key: VICTORIA: Well... not exactly?
en: VICTORIA: Well... not exactly?
ja: ヴィクトリア: えっと…そういうわけでも?

key: We ended up down here by accident and were just trying to find a way out...
en: We ended up down here by accident and were just trying to find a way out...
ja: 偶然ここまで来ちゃって、出口を探してただけなの…

key: But I'm sure Team Meteor never would expect us to come through a way that requires blowing through some old tunnel.
en: But I'm sure Team Meteor never would expect us to come through a way that requires blowing through some old tunnel.
ja: でも、古いトンネルを爆破して通るなんて方法、チームメテオも予想してないはずよ。

key: Maybe this is our chance?
en: Maybe this is our chance?
ja: これがチャンスかもしれない?

key: HARDY: I follow, mate!
en: HARDY: I follow, mate!
ja: ハーディ: なるほどな、相棒!

key: You're sayin' we take this bit around and see if it can get us to them from another angle, right?
en: You're sayin' we take this bit around and see if it can get us to them from another angle, right?
ja: つまりこっちを回って、別の角度からあいつらのところに行けるか試そうってことだろ?

key: VICTORIA: In a best case scenario, we would either move right past them undetected, or come up behind them and take them by surprise.
en: VICTORIA: In a best case scenario, we would either move right past them undetected, or come up behind them and take them by surprise.
ja: ヴィクトリア: うまくいけば、気づかれずに通り過ぎるか、背後から不意打ちできるはず。

key: HARDY: Sounds good to me!
en: HARDY: Sounds good to me!
ja: ハーディ: いいじゃねえか!

key: Let's get rolling then!
en: Let's get rolling then!
ja: じゃあ、行こうぜ!

key: TITANIA: It's not exactly the most direct route, but it'll have to do.
en: TITANIA: It's not exactly the most direct route, but it'll have to do.
ja: ティタニア: 一番の近道ってわけじゃないけど、これで我慢するしかないわね。

key: ...Oh, it's you.
en: ...Oh, it's you.
ja: …あら、あなたね。

key: TITANIA: Try not to sound too excited.
en: TITANIA: Try not to sound too excited.
ja: ティタニア: そんなにうれしそうにしないでよ。

key: Still haven't found your damsel?
en: Still haven't found your damsel?
ja: まだお姫様は見つからないの?

key: HARDY: Finding her ain't the problem; gettin' to her is.
en: HARDY: Finding her ain't the problem; gettin' to her is.
ja: ハーディ: 見つけるのが問題じゃねえ、そこにたどり着くのが問題なんだ。

key: TITANIA: What a hero you make.
en: TITANIA: What a hero you make.
ja: ティタニア: ずいぶんとヒーロー気取りね。

key: HARDY: Stow it, sis.
en: HARDY: Stow it, sis.
ja: ハーディ: だまってろよ、姉貴。

key: Just cuz somethin' ain't done yet doesn't mean it won't be!
en: Just cuz somethin' ain't done yet doesn't mean it won't be!
ja: まだできてないからって、これからもできないとは限らねえだろ!

key: TITANIA: Nor does it mean it will.
en: TITANIA: Nor does it mean it will.
ja: ティタニア: できるとも限らないけどね。

key: HARDY: What's that supposed to mean, huh?
en: HARDY: What's that supposed to mean, huh?
ja: ハーディ: どういう意味だよ、それ?

key: TITANIA: If wanting to save something was enough to actually do it, none of us would be here right now.
en: TITANIA: If wanting to save something was enough to actually do it, none of us would be here right now.
ja: ティタニア: 何かを救いたいと思うだけで実現できるなら、あたしたちは誰もここにいないはずよ。

key: Whether it's adrenaline or something else, you're too caught in the rush to even see reality.
en: Whether it's adrenaline or something else, you're too caught in the rush to even see reality.
ja: アドレナリンのせいか何か知らないけど、あなたは興奮しすぎて現実が見えていない。

key: HARDY: It ain't just that!
en: HARDY: It ain't just that!
ja: ハーディ: それだけじゃねえ!

key: I'm gonna save her, because she needs me to!
en: I'm gonna save her, because she needs me to!
ja: 彼女を救うんだ、彼女が俺を必要としてるからだ!

key: TITANIA: You're going to talk a lot about saving her and fail to make any difference because you haven't actually thought anything through.
en: TITANIA: You're going to talk a lot about saving her and fail to make any difference because you haven't actually thought anything through.
ja: ティタニア: あなたはさんざん彼女を救うって語るだけで、何一つ考えを詰めてないから、結局何も変えられない。

key: HARDY: So what, you got some kind of plan?
en: HARDY: So what, you got some kind of plan?
ja: ハーディ: じゃあ何か、お前に何か作戦があるってのか?

key: TITANIA: Sure.
en: TITANIA: Sure.
ja: ティタニア: ええ、あるわ。

key: Find Lin; put her down.
en: Find Lin; put her down.
ja: リンを見つけて、仕留める。

key: Cut off the head and the rest will die.
en: Cut off the head and the rest will die.
ja: 頭を切り落とせば、残りは死ぬ。

key: HARDY: I heard that worked out real well for you in your gym, huh.
en: HARDY: I heard that worked out real well for you in your gym, huh.
ja: ハーディ: それ、お前のジムでもさぞうまくいったんだろうな。

key: TITANIA: ...
en: TITANIA: ...
ja: ティタニア: …

key: No human could've withstood the wounds I gave her.
en: No human could've withstood the wounds I gave her.
ja: 人間なら、あたしが与えたあの傷に耐えられるはずがない。

key: Something is wrong,
en: Something is wrong,
ja: 何かがおかしい、

key: But it doesn't matter.
en: But it doesn't matter.
ja: でも、それは関係ない。

key: If just killing her isn't enough, then I'll cut off her head.
en: If just killing her isn't enough, then I'll cut off her head.
ja: ただ殺すだけで足りないなら、頭を切り落とす。

key: And if that's not enough, I'll cut all of her into tiny pieces.
en: And if that's not enough, I'll cut all of her into tiny pieces.
ja: それでも足りないなら、全部細切れにする。

key: And if she still shows signs of life, I'll seal those pieces in iron and scatter them across the world.
en: And if she still shows signs of life, I'll seal those pieces in iron and scatter them across the world.
ja: それでもまだ生きてる兆候があるなら、その破片を鉄に封じて世界中にばらまく。

key: We have to know what she is in order to know how to fight her.
en: We have to know what she is in order to know how to fight her.
ja: 戦い方を知るには、あいつが何者かを知る必要がある。

key: All of that starts with killing her first, and watching what happens.
en: All of that starts with killing her first, and watching what happens.
ja: そのすべては、まず殺してみて、何が起こるか見ることから始まる。

key: That's how you make a plan; know what you don't know, and learn how to learn it.
en: That's how you make a plan; know what you don't know, and learn how to learn it.
ja: 作戦っていうのはそうやって立てるものよ。知らないことを把握して、それを知る方法を学ぶ。

key: HARDY: And what about Aya?
en: HARDY: And what about Aya?
ja: ハーディ: じゃあアヤはどうなんだよ?

key: TITANIA: What about Aya?
en: TITANIA: What about Aya?
ja: ティタニア: アヤがどうしたの?

key: HARDY: You'll spend all that time deadset on Lin while the others still have Aya!
en: HARDY: You'll spend all that time deadset on Lin while the others still have Aya!
ja: ハーディ: お前がリンにばっかりこだわってる間も、あいつらはずっとアヤを捕まえたままなんだぞ!

key: TITANIA: Treat the cause; not the symptom.
en: TITANIA: Treat the cause; not the symptom.
ja: ティタニア: 症状じゃなくて原因を治すのよ。

key: HARDY: Aya is suffering!
en: HARDY: Aya is suffering!
ja: ハーディ: アヤは苦しんでるんだ!

key: You'd just leave her?!
en: You'd just leave her?!
ja: それでも放っておくつもりかよ?!

key: TITANIA: She's been suffering. A little longer won't kill her.
en: TITANIA: She's been suffering. A little longer won't kill her.
ja: ティタニア: ずっと苦しんできたんでしょ。もう少し長引いたところで死にはしない。

key: HARDY: You don't know that!
en: HARDY: You don't know that!
ja: ハーディ: そんなのわかんねえだろ!

key: You know what they're like-- they'll do anything to win!
en: You know what they're like-- they'll do anything to win!
ja: あいつらがどんな奴らかわかってるだろ――勝つためなら何でもする奴らだぞ!

key: TITANIA: So must we.
en: TITANIA: So must we.
ja: ティタニア: だからあたしたちもそうしなきゃ。

key: And that means choosing our priorities wisely.
en: And that means choosing our priorities wisely.
ja: つまり、優先順位を賢く選ぶってこと。

key: Aya is not a critical piece in defeating Team Meteor.
en: Aya is not a critical piece in defeating Team Meteor.
ja: アヤはチームメテオを倒す上で重要な駒じゃない。

key: The only thing she's critical to is making you feel needed.
en: The only thing she's critical to is making you feel needed.
ja: アヤが重要なのは、あなたが必要とされてる気分になれるってことだけ。

key: You're putting your ego above what's actually important.
en: You're putting your ego above what's actually important.
ja: あなたは本当に大事なことより、自分のプライドを優先してる。

key: HARDY: And you're tossing her life away!
en: HARDY: And you're tossing her life away!
ja: ハーディ: お前はあいつの命を投げ捨ててるんだよ!

key: TITANIA: What are you going to do about it?
en: TITANIA: What are you going to do about it?
ja: ティタニア: それで、あなたはどうするつもり?

key: HARDY: I'll save her!
en: HARDY: I'll save her!
ja: ハーディ: 俺が救う!

key: I'll find another way around and prove to you that she doesn't have to just be a casualty!
en: I'll find another way around and prove to you that she doesn't have to just be a casualty!
ja: 別の道を見つけて、あいつがただの犠牲者になる必要なんてないって証明してやる!

key: TITANIA: So the same thing you were already set on doing.
en: TITANIA: So the same thing you were already set on doing.
ja: ティタニア: つまり、最初からやるつもりだったことと同じね。

key: Glad to see this conversation made any difference.
en: Glad to see this conversation made any difference.
ja: この会話が何か意味を持ったみたいで良かったわ。

key: I don't really know what else I expected though.
en: I don't really know what else I expected though.
ja: 他に何を期待してたのかもよくわからないけど。

key: You've always been short-sighted and hard-headed.
en: You've always been short-sighted and hard-headed.
ja: あなたは昔から近視眼的で頑固だった。

key: HARDY: Must run in the family.
en: HARDY: Must run in the family.
ja: ハーディ: 家系ってやつだろ。

key: TITANIA: Likely.
en: TITANIA: Likely.
ja: ティタニア: だろうね。

key: Neither of us are getting anywhere standing here arguing.
en: Neither of us are getting anywhere standing here arguing.
ja: ここで言い争っててもどっちも先に進まない。

key: You go your way; we'll go ours.
en: You go your way; we'll go ours.
ja: あなたはあなたの道を、あたしたちはあたしたちの道を行く。

key: HARDY: Hold on now, who's to say that \PN is going with you?!
en: HARDY: Hold on now, who's to say that \PN is going with you?!
ja: ハーディ: おい待てよ、\PNがお前らと一緒に行くって誰が決めたんだ?!

key: TITANIA: That wasn't literal.
en: TITANIA: That wasn't literal.
ja: ティタニア: 別に文字通りの意味で言ったんじゃないわ。

key: Right now all we can do is move forward anyway.
en: Right now all we can do is move forward anyway.
ja: とにかく今できるのは、前に進むことだけ。

key: We'll have time to argue about what to do once there's actually a choice in the matter.
en: We'll have time to argue about what to do once there's actually a choice in the matter.
ja: 実際に選択肢が出てきたら、何をするか言い争う時間もあるでしょ。

key: And if we don't have time then, we won't be losing much.
en: And if we don't have time then, we won't be losing much.
ja: その時間がなかったとしても、大した損失じゃない。

key: HARDY: Tch.
en: HARDY: Tch.
ja: ハーディ: チッ。

key: You know, she wasn't always like this.
en: You know, she wasn't always like this.
ja: なあ、姉貴も昔からこうだったわけじゃねえんだ。

key: Nothin' anyone says is gonna stop me from saving her, yanno?
en: Nothin' anyone says is gonna stop me from saving her, yanno?
ja: 誰が何言おうと、俺が彼女を救うのは止められねえからな。

key: Let's not waste anymore time for it!
en: Let's not waste anymore time for it!
ja: もう時間を無駄にするのはよそうぜ!

key: An old area map is posted here.
en: An old area map is posted here.
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている。

key: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
en: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
ja: 長い間、誰も手をつけていないようだ。

key: Tapu Quest completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Tapu Quest completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルでタプクエストのクリアが確認された。

key: Skip terrain activation on this file?
en: Skip terrain activation on this file?
ja: このファイルでフィールド起動をスキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
